result.evidence_quote: Here, we have investigated an in vitro, reproducible murine-based model for bone marrow-derived, glioma-educated macrophages (gTAMs) and performed rigorous analysis to expand our understanding of gTAMs to provide a validated tool for investigating therapeutic response.
result.rationale: The study directly addresses cancer biology by modeling glioblastoma-associated macrophages implicated in an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment and immunotherapy resistance. Its validated experimental model supports investigation of cancer therapeutic responses.
